description: WSP is a global professional services firm providing engineering, design, environmental and advisory services for transport, buildings, energy and natural-resource projects. It reports four geographic segments and tracks net revenues across four sectors.

segments.name: Americas
segments.description: The United States and Latin America, WSP's largest segment.

segments.name: Canada
segments.description: WSP's home market, serving public and private clients across Canada.

segments.name: EMEIA
segments.description: Europe, the Middle East, India and Africa, including the UK and the Nordics.

business_lines.name: Earth & Environment
business_lines.description: Earth-science and environmental services, including permitting, compliance, remediation, geotechnical and mining engineering, water resources and impact assessments.

business_lines.name: Power & Energy
business_lines.description: Engineering for energy projects, including renewables, nuclear, natural gas, power plants, transmission, substations, distribution and storage.

business_lines.name: Private sector
business_lines.description: Net revenues from private sector clients.

business_lines.name: Property & Buildings
business_lines.description: Technical and advisory services for commercial buildings and social and critical infrastructure, from business case and design to asset management and refurbishment.

business_lines.name: Public sector
business_lines.description: Net revenues from government and other public sector clients.

business_lines.name: Transport & Infrastructure
business_lines.description: Advisory, planning, design and project management for rail, transit, aviation, highways, bridges, tunnels, water, maritime and urban infrastructure.

subsidiaries.name: 1A Ingenieros
subsidiaries.description: Spanish consulting firm of about 250 employees, mainly in Power & Energy, acquired in May 2024.

Communica Public Affairs

subsidiaries.name: Lexica

subsidiaries.name: Proxion
subsidiaries.description: Engineering firms (Proxion Plan Oy and Proxion Pro Oy) acquired in March 2024.

subsidiaries.name: Ricardo
subsidiaries.description: Engineering and environmental consultancy acquired in October 2025.

subsidiaries.description: Engineering and consulting firm acquired in February 2026, strong in Power & Energy; about 9% of revenues in the first nine months of 2026.
